title: Exhaustive Ancient Korean & Japanese Genealogy (Samguk Yusa, Samguk Sagi, Kojiki & Nihon Shoki)

nodes.name: Hwanin (Lord of Heaven) → Hwanung & Ungnyeo
sources: Samguk Yusa (1281 CE, citing lost Gogi)
nodes.notes: Hwanung descends from Heaven to Mt. Taebaek with 3,000 followers and the gods of Wind, Rain, and Clouds; weds Ungnyeo (the bear who endured 100 days of mugwort and garlic to become human).

nodes.name: Dangun Wanggeom (Founder of Gojoseon, 2333 BCE trad.) → Buru
nodes.role: Founding Ancestor of the Korean People
nodes.notes: Son of Hwanung & Ungnyeo; founded Gojoseon (Asadal) in the traditional era of Chinese Emperor Yao! Father of Prince Buru (who in Korean annals meets Yu the Great at Tushan!).

nodes.name: Hae Mosu + Yuhwa → King Dongmyeong (Jumong — Goguryeo)
nodes.notes: Born from a luminous egg to Yuhwa (daughter of River God Habaek) and heavenly prince Hae Mosu; founded the northern kingdom of Goguryeo (leading to King Yuri and King Gwanggaeto the Great!).

nodes.name: Soseono → Onjo (Founder of Baekje) → King Geunchogo
nodes.role: Founder of Baekje & Royal Bridge to Yamato Japan!
nodes.notes: Onjo (son of Jumong & Lady Soseono) founded Baekje in SW Korea; Baekje became Yamato Japan's closest ally, transmitting Chinese writing (Wani), Buddhism, and royal intermarriage (Emperor Kammu's mother descended from Baekje's King Muryeong!)!

nodes.name: Park Hyeokgeose (+ Aryeong), Seok Talhae & Kim Alji (Silla)
nodes.role: Founding Clans of Silla (Park, Seok & Kim)
nodes.notes: Park Hyeokgeose (born from a luminous egg at Najeong well) founded Silla; joined by Seok Talhae and Kim Alji (born from a golden box in Gyerim forest — ancestor of Queen Seondeok & unified Silla kings!).

nodes.name: King Suro of Gaya + Queen Heo Hwang-ok (Princess of Ayuta / India!)
nodes.role: India ↔ Korea Royal Marriage Bridge (Gimhae Kim & Heo Clans)
nodes.notes: King Suro (born from one of 6 golden eggs on Mt. Guji) married Princess Heo Hwang-ok (Suriratna), who sailed to Korea from the Kingdom of Ayuta (traditionally identified with Ayodhya, India — capital of the Solar Dynasty!) carrying a stone pagoda. Ancestors of millions of Gimhae Kim & Heo Koreans!

nodes.name: Ame-no-Minakanushi, Takamimusubi & Kamimusubi
nodes.notes: Three primordial creation deities appearing at the dawn of Heaven and Earth; Takamimusubi is the maternal grandfather of Ninigi!

nodes.name: Izanagi & Izanami (Creators of the Japanese Islands)
nodes.notes: Stir the primeval ocean with the heavenly jeweled spear Amenonuhoko to birth Onogoro and the Eight Great Islands of Japan, plus Fire God Kagutsuchi and the Three Noble Children.

nodes.name: Amaterasu-Omikami (Sun Goddess) & Tsukuyomi (Moon)
nodes.role: Supreme Sun Goddess / Ancestress of Japan's Emperors
nodes.notes: Born from Izanagi's left eye upon purifying himself from Yomi (the Underworld); ruler of the High Plain of Heaven (Takamagahara) and divine ancestress of the Imperial House of Japan.

nodes.name: Susanoo-no-Mikoto (+ Kushinadahime) → Okuninushi (Izumo)
nodes.notes: Brother of Amaterasu; slays the eight-headed serpent Yamata-no-Orochi to win the Kusanagi sword, marries Kushinadahime, and sires the Izumo dynasty leading to Okuninushi (who builds Izumo and cedes the land to Amaterasu's grandson Ninigi!).

nodes.name: Ame-no-Oshihomimi & Ninigi-no-Mikoto (+ Konohanasakuya-hime)
nodes.role: Grandson of Amaterasu Bearing the Three Imperial Regalia
nodes.notes: Amaterasu's son Ame-no-Oshihomimi weds Takamimusubi's daughter and sires Ninigi, who descends to Mt. Takachiho (Kyushu) carrying the Mirror, Jewel, and Sword (Three Imperial Regalia) and marries Mt. Fuji goddess Konohanasakuya-hime!

nodes.name: Hoderi & Hoori (+ Toyotama-hime) → Ugayafukiaezu
nodes.notes: Hoori (Yamasachihiko) journeys to the underwater palace of Sea God Ryujin/Watatsumi, weds sea princess Toyotama-hime, and fathers Ugayafukiaezu -> Emperor Jimmu!

nodes.name: Emperor Jimmu (Kamu-yamato Iware-biko, 1st Emperor)
nodes.role: Founder of the Imperial House of Japan (Yamato)
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Ninigi; leads the Eastern Expedition from Kyushu to Yamato (Nara), guided by the three-legged crow Yatagarasu, founding the world's oldest continuous hereditary monarchy!

nodes.name: Emperor Sujin (10th) → Emperor Keiko → Prince Yamato Takeru
nodes.role: First Historical Yamato Anchor & Heroic Prince
nodes.notes: Emperor Sujin is widely regarded as the earliest historically grounded Yamato ruler; his descendant Prince Yamato Takeru wields Susanoo's Kusanagi sword to unify Honshu.

nodes.name: Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku
nodes.role: Yamato Emperors & Architects of Korean/Chinese Cultural Bridge
nodes.notes: Emperor Ojin (deified as Hachiman) welcomed Baekje Korean scholar Wani (bringing Chinese characters and Confucius's Analects to Japan!); Prince Shotoku (574-622 CE) established Buddhism and Japan's 17-Article Constitution!
